_comment: v3.66.1221 row-234 battery: a worker that dies mid-test must leave the nodeid it was running, and a worker that FINISHES must not. The clearing mutant is the reason this spec exists as a tracked artifact -- the first version of its catcher was VACUOUS (one marker per worker, overwritten by every logstart, so a stale marker could never be observed mid-run) and the battery is what found that.
subject: v3.66.1221 -- a dying xdist worker names the test it was running

mutants.label: the marker is never written: logstart records only the file
the marker is never cleared, so a finished test looks like a death
the write stops being atomic, so a reader can catch a fragment
mutants.old:
tmp = target.with_suffix(".current.tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(str(nodeid) + "\n")
        fh.flush()
        os.fsync(fh.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, target)
mutants.new:
with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for _ch in str(nodeid) + "\n":
            fh.write(_ch)
            fh.flush()

mutants.label: the reader reports nothing, so a death is unattributable again
the summary stops announcing a stranded worker
